git_checkout.reuse_rule: Real Git checkout mode is retained only for developer/CI contexts that genuinely operate from Git metadata. It is not attempted by ChatGPT/Work planner execution.
git_checkout.cleanliness_rule: When real Git checkout mode is explicitly used outside ChatGPT/Work, planner Python must execute from a clean detached snapshot whose HEAD exactly equals rules_source_sha.
git_checkout.authentication_rule: Developer/CI Git mode uses that environment's Git authorization. ChatGPT/Work never tests or repairs Git authentication before connector acquisition.
git_checkout.failure_rule: A Git checkout failure outside ChatGPT/Work is local to that execution context. It must not be emitted as a ChatGPT/Work planner bootstrap failure.

repository_identity.source: Exact current-main commit SHA returned by the authorized GitHub connector/API for ChatGPT/Work

connector_materialization.source_bytes: The complete decoded UTF-8 content returned by GitHub connector/API responses for the exact requested path and rules_source_sha is the canonical file content.
connector_materialization.preferred_fetch: Fetch the complete file in one response when possible.

chunked_fetch_fallback.trigger: Use when a connector/UI response is truncated, clipped or elided because the file is large.
chunked_fetch_fallback.method: Refetch the same path and exact rules_source_sha with explicit non-overlapping start_line/end_line ranges until every source line has been obtained, then concatenate ranges in ascending order preserving original newline boundaries.
prohibited: retyping or reconstructing from a truncated visible excerpt
treating one truncated presentation response as source unavailability

blob_verification.expected_sha_source: GitHub connector/API blob identity for the exact path/ref
blob_verification.failure_rule: Fail closed if reconstructed bytes do not match the connector-returned Git blob SHA/equivalent canonical blob identity.

evidence_file.rule: Record the connector-returned exact rules_source_sha and Git blob SHA/equivalent canonical blob identity for every required materialized file, including PLANNER_MATERIALIZATION.json itself. This evidence is generated during connector acquisition; do not invent or infer SHAs.

completion_gate.pass_rule: Canonical ChatGPT/Work materialization is complete only when materialization_verify returns status=PASS. Continue immediately to planner_contract and media_readiness after PASS.
completion_gate.early_return_rule: Do not return merely because connector files are not yet materialized. Materialization is work the current planner invocation must perform when connector/API access and local file execution are available.
completion_gate.blocked_status_rule: MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKED is legal only after a named exact-SHA connector fetch/reconstruction/write fails, connector evidence is invalid, or materialization_verify returns FAIL. Report the exact path/operation and verifier error code; Git/DNS/checkout failures are not valid ChatGPT/Work materialization blockers.

connector_materialization.write_rule: ChatGPT/Work creates parent directories and writes verified connector-returned content directly to ordinary local files at repository-relative paths under a temporary materialization root. No .git metadata is required.
connector_materialization.failure_rule: Fail closed when a required exact-SHA source range cannot be fetched, reconstructed bytes fail blob verification, bytes cannot be written, materialization_verify returns FAIL, or a required canonical Python entrypoint fails after writing.

source_rule: For ChatGPT/Work, resolve current main through the authorized GitHub connector/API, materialize PLANNER_MATERIALIZATION.json itself plus shared_required_python_files and shared_required_data_files and only the selected profile additions from one exact rules_source_sha, record connector-returned per-file evidence, and pass planning.materialization_verify before planner checkpoints. Never attempt shell Git first. No production promotion or publishing module is required merely to execute planner-time Python.

immutable_cache.shared_cache_scope: blob-verified shared_required_python_files + shared_required_data_files for the identical connector-resolved SHA
immutable_cache.validation_rule: ChatGPT/Work cache reuse is valid only when previously verified connector blob identities belong to the identical rules_source_sha manifest entry. Developer/CI real-Git reuse is a separate execution mode.
immutable_cache.sha_change_rule: A newer connector-returned current-main SHA must be classified by planner-relevant drift before reusing prior planning work. Never silently execute planner Python from stale source bytes.

planner_state_placeholders.rule: For explicit existence/uniqueness checks in ChatGPT/Work connector mode, materialize zero-byte placeholder files for matching canonical repository paths when only path existence is required. Their contents are not read by those checks. Real Git checkout mode outside ChatGPT/Work may read repository state directly.

drift_policy.chatgpt_work_detection: Re-query current main through the authorized GitHub connector/API immediately before immutable commit and compare that SHA with rules_source_sha. No shell Git network command is used.

categories.rules: refresh source snapshot; rerun materialization verification, planner contract, media readiness and complete precommit
categories.media: refresh media state; rerun media readiness, background selection validation and complete precommit
categories.history: refresh creative/history inputs; rerun duplicate, analytics and recent-background reasoning; rerun complete precommit whenever authored pool bytes change
categories.operational: do not restart planning solely for operational evidence/recovery/completion changes

drift_policy.connector_rule: If connector/API current-main SHA changes, obtain exact-SHA state and connector/API changed-path evidence when available, then apply the same planning.planner_drift category policy. If a trustworthy changed-path set is unavailable, conservatively perform a full refresh.

performance_diagnostics.rule: Measure with a monotonic clock around actual work. Diagnostics are observability only and must not influence creative ranking or validation. Git-specific fields apply only to explicit developer/CI real-Git mode.

baseline.optimization: Connector/API exact-SHA materialization is canonical for ChatGPT/Work. Reuse verified bytes only for the identical SHA; real Git checkout optimization is restricted to developer/CI contexts.

forbidden_bootstrap_requirements: running planner Python from an unpinned mutable checkout
silently mixing source/state files from different commits
using stale cached source after current-main connector resolution changes
ChatGPT/Work git fetch before connector/API acquisition
ChatGPT/Work git clone before connector/API acquisition
ChatGPT/Work git pull before connector/API acquisition
ChatGPT/Work git ls-remote before connector/API acquisition
ChatGPT/Work git rev-parse origin/main before connector/API acquisition
returning a Git/DNS/checkout failure before connector/API materialization
returning early merely because connector materialization work has not yet been performed
generic MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKED without an exact failed path/operation or verifier error
